transcriber_notes: Low-resolution (1259x856) screenshot of a SnowPro-style Windows form; no app branding visible -> source_format 'other'. Printed date 22/11/2012 (D/M/Y) agrees with the file name. Elevation printed 2140 m (the 2012-12-08 chart of the same plot prints 2300 m); transcribed as printed. Height axis 2.7 px/cm with 10 cm gridlines, BUT the image is locally compressed between the 110 and 90 cm gridlines (46 px instead of 54; the 100 gridline is missing, the '100' label and the 'Surface> 102' label are cut), the same artefact as in the other SnowPro screenshots of this batch. Surface/bar top reads 102.2 on the upper scale (matches HS 102); boundaries below 90 read on the lower scale (90 at y454, 0 at y697). Boundaries 102/94/84/68/35/34/27/26/25/22/0 from bar edges (each bar's top border row matches an integer cm) and the H-column leader lines; table rows mapped one-to-one to the drawn layers. Hardness axis non-linear (K, P, 1F, 4F, F at 216/108/54/27/~13 px from the bar origin). Bars: F, 4F, 4F+ (6 px past 4F), 1F, 1F+ (13 px past 1F), 4F+, P+ (40 px past P), 1F, P+, P; the R-column icons (/ = 4F, X = 1F, // = P, with +) agree with every bar. Temperatures on 13.5 px/deg C (0 C at the 4F/0 gridline): the dashed air segment ends at the surface at -5.2 (= printed Surface Temp) and the solid snow-temperature line starts there without a marker (recorded as 102 cm); the first circle sits 5.5 px above the 90 cm circle, i.e. ~92 cm (inside the compressed band, height approximate); no 100 cm marker is visible. Markers at 60-0 cm are inside the hatched bars (+-0.1-0.2 C). Tests have no leader lines, so heights are null.
